features.apple: MainMenu.nib Edit > Copy, Select All; Tools > Text Selection
features.note: Edit > Copy (Cmd+C) takes the PDF text lines inside the selection's band, or the whole page, from the PDF worker (find.rs copy_text) to the clipboard; a picture copies as PNG; Edit > Select All (Cmd+A) selects the shown page. Lines, not words: the extraction has no word positions, so there is no drag-to-select on the page. Not yet checked on the lab machine
Tools > Select drags a rectangle; Tools > Crop (Cmd+K) keeps it for pictures and moves the markup with it; Select All selects the shown page. Crop for PDF pages is not done

Tools > Adjust Size (Cmd+Option+I) takes a width, a width x height or a percentage in the status line and resamples the picture; export-at-scale stays in the File menu. No sheet with a keep-ratio switch yet

Adjust > Show Adjust Color shows sliders for exposure, contrast, saturation and temperature on the right side; a drag is one undo step. Sharpness has no filter in the render engine yet; the Adjust menu steps stay

Tools > Instant Alpha clears the connected region of one colour around the click to transparent, undoable; not yet checked on the lab machine

features.apple: MainMenu.nib Tools > Annotate > Underline/Strike Through Text
features.note: Tools menu Underline and Strike Through draw along a rectangle's bottom or middle, saved as Underline and StrikeOut annotations. Not yet on a text selection, since the text layer has no word positions

Tools > Text Box places a box at a click; the typed text is drawn in it and saved as a FreeText annotation in Helvetica (pdfmarks.rs:174). Text boxes are not burned into exported pictures yet. Not yet checked on the lab machine

Tools > Save Signature keeps the page's drawn strokes in a library of nine (signature.rs, data folder); Tools > Insert Signature places one centred at 30% of the page width, as one undo step. No signature picker panel yet
Tools > Redact draws a black box that is burned into saved and exported pictures. Pictures only: a PDF keeps the text under a box, so the tool is refused there
